title: Open-String Note Names on Guitar with Mnemonics (E A D G B E)
summary: This JustinGuitar lesson teaches the note names of the guitar’s open strings and introduces mnemonic devices to help beginners memorize them. The core mnemonic presented is Eddie Ate Dynamite Good Bye Eddie, mapping to the open-string notes E–A–D–G–B–E, with explicit verbal confirmation of the sequence. The video also discusses alternative mnemonics (including a humorous older variant and a community-driven example) and notes that mnemonics can be self-created to suit the learner. Beyond the primary mnemonic, the instructor emphasizes the importance of remembering open-string names as a foundation for learning the fretboard, clarifies string numbering (string 1 is the thinnest, string 6 the thickest), and mentions potential ambiguity caused by two E strings when using certain naming conventions. The lesson culminates with guidance to memorize the open-string notes before advancing to the next lesson, and cross-references a related Music Theory course for further mnemonic experimentation.
